spells.procedure:
WOVEN THREADS — selected complete proposed procedure.
KEEP: Divination rank5, base10RP, Action,60feet,V/S/F, one perceived creature, WIS resistance, alteration of the genuinely last minute and Instantaneous duration. Retain all six actual class routes and their exact level gates. MC3-CAST-120, MC3-READY-120, MC3-MEMORY-120 and MC3-RECOVERY-120 apply only within their written scopes.
NEW temporal declaration: choose Erase or Replace and either FIXED absolute [a,b), 0<b-a<=60, or RELATIVE offsets [-u,-v),0<=v<u<=60. A direct cast anchors relative offsets at its legal commitment; a readied cast fixes those offsets at preparation but anchors them at its legal release. Explicit absolute timestamps never move. Freeze the resulting interval and payload before saves, private eligibility or interruption outcomes; no post-result retargeting. At the initial direct declaration or Ready preparation, the fixed interval must be within that then-eligible preceding minute; a knowingly impossible fixed plan is rejected before preparation/direct payment. A lawful fixed plan that subsequently ages is not rebound at release: its stated temporal payload check occurs at resolution after an otherwise legal release has spent its Reaction. The controller may decline release under ordinary Ready, but aging supplies no refund or replacement interval. A RELATIVE plan is instantiated at direct commitment or Ready release before private results, then remains fixed. At effect resolution t, revalidate against [t-60,t). Erase applies only the still-valid intersection and the actual experienced/event-selected portions inside it; a partly aged interval can therefore be partly erased with the same full payment. A wholly aged/empty intersection does nothing. Replace requires its ENTIRE fixed time interval still to lie inside the resolution window; partial aging makes that replacement fail wholly, because automatically trimming or retiming its narrative would change the fixed content. This asymmetry is explicit NEW scope, not a generic casting rule. A relative plan is anchored once, never slid again after a delay. Both temporal failures are paid when lawful commitment already occurred, give no new interval/target and no hidden diagnostic. Temporal validation is distinct from the recipient's private experience capacity.
Erase may select the whole interval or one clearly described event/facet predicate using at most60 ordinary whitespace-delimited words; an empty event description means the whole interval. Replace supplies one coherent first-person sensory narrative of at most60 such words covering no more than that fixed interval. Ordinary linguistic words count; identifiers/code/concatenation cannot bypass the content limit. The caster must actually know the described concepts, not the unknown original memory. It may assert false events using known concepts, but supplies no proficiency, formula, language, repertoire, genuine consent or factual omniscience. No hearing/shared language is needed for simple sensory content; semantic content the target cannot actually understand is not translated or taught. Replace changes only actual personally experienced eligible portions; absent experience/unconsciousness cannot become a training slot or an invented original. Preserve the entire declared narrative and record unsupported semantic facets privately rather than substituting a different story.
At resolution require actual creature, current perception/range/line of effect and memory capacity/protection eligibility. Roll one native WIS save if there is an otherwise operative mental application; success leaves recall unchanged. Failure applies the selected permissible change once. A hidden capacity/protection failure or nonexistent experience provides no readout, fallback event, prior timestamp or control effect. Actual suppression at the target prevents the local mental application before its payload; no save/overlay is invented for a fully suppressed output.
On successful application write a private source/owner/recipient/originalDC/root/event ledger and change accessible recollection instantly. There is no ongoing concentration, fixed expiry, repeated save or later dispellable field. Completed external events, physical records, resources, injuries, skills and independent commands persist. No caster success notification or forced future decision is added. Preserve all earlier memory provenance under later edits. Shared recovery can subsequently remove this family's supported portions against the highest relevant originalDC without restoring an independent Disrupt Memory loss. Ended or recovered history remains stored; death/revival, ordinary rest and loading are not replay/reset permissions.

Snapshot every creature in the sphere with caster-origin line of effect, including the caster and allies; no selective omission or individual-perception requirement. A hidden creature can be affected without being revealed. Each makes INT. Success leaves memory unchanged. Failure removes accessible firsthand episodic recall of experiences during the 60 elapsed seconds immediately preceding resolution, but only experiences that the creature actually had. Unconscious intervals with no experience, absent witnesses and beings without the relevant memory capacity do not acquire fabricated experiences or a substitute older interval. No shared language or sight of the spell is needed; actual mental/memory protections retain their scope.

NEW this is an instantaneous lasting memory change, not a one-minute ongoing fog. There is no concentration, expiry, concealed area, visual obscuration, continuing entrant effect, replacement narrative or private-memory readout. Ordinary dispelling or later antimagic does not undo a completed alteration. The recipient cannot recall a newly heard password solely through the erased experience, but existing independent older knowledge and external notes remain available. General identity, trained proficiencies, actual class/repertoire grants, completed legitimate training and older memories are not deleted merely because the creature used or thought about them during that minute. Events, injuries, statuses, resources, consumptions, actions, contracts and all other people's unaffected evidence remain real. This source does not independently end concentration; Disrupt Memory's explicit concentration-ending clause is not a universal memory rule.

Record the actual original episode/event provenance before applying the inaccessible-memory layer. Each new cast has its own resolution-relative last-minute window. Erasing a present recollection of yesterday does not erase yesterday's underlying memory, and revisiting an older fabricated story cannot reset its event date. Repeated paid casts over genuinely passing time can affect additional genuinely recent intervals; this source supplies no overall one-minute lifetime cap, but it also supplies no backdated or recursive reach. Empty or protected portions give no hidden diagnostic and cannot be substituted with another person's experiences. Actual noticing of a gap, suspicion, testimony and investigation remain possible without an automatic identification of the caster.

NEW recovery proposal: a genuinely applicable effect expressly restoring altered memories uses its own procedure. Otherwise, after encountering specific credible independent evidence contradicting the alteration or establishing an erased event, the recipient may spend ten uninterrupted minutes examining that episode and make WIS/Insight. Use the highest original spell DC among currently operative Haze of Forgetting and Woven Threads alterations covering the selected episode. Ordinary task degrees apply: Success/Critical Success restores the actual originally experienced portion; failure provides no false certainty, and a retry needs materially new evidence or method. The same unsupported assertion is not infinite retries. This shared recovery rule is an explicit proposed extension to the prior unadopted Woven Threads draft, requiring joint agreement; it is not silently applied as a reviewed correction.

On successful recovery under this new shared rule, remove the current Haze/Woven overlays over the recovered portion and restore the true original episode, not an earlier adversary's invented layer. Unrelated intervals and other named memory effects retain their own rules. Disrupt Memory's reviewed six-second firsthand loss does not gain this new evidence-restoration permission merely by overlap; if that independent effect still removes a portion, learning evidence can create new knowledge without overriding its own recovery rules. Death/revival, rests, initiative changes and recasts do not reset the retained memory provenance. The spell dictates no future belief or decision based on the missing interval and cannot manufacture consent by making someone forget an objection.
workedCases: EN6-02-A: At elapsed time 120, the caster and three witnesses stand inside the 30-foot sphere. All four make INT, including the caster. Failed saves affect their actually experienced interval from time 60 up to resolution at 120. A witness asleep for the first thirty seconds loses only actual later experience. The spilled ink, spent RP, wounds and a written receipt remain unchanged; the spell supplies neither a replacement story nor an announcement of which hidden witnesses failed.

EN6-02-B: A genuine episode is covered by a DC16 Haze layer and a DC18 Woven Threads alteration. With credible independent evidence, ten minutes of examination uses Insight DC18 under the explicitly new shared recovery proposal. Success restores the true experienced portion and removes those two proposal-family overlays; it does not erase an independent Disrupt Memory prohibition or grant facts never observed. A later low-DC recast cannot lower this recovery DC or use a present recollection to reach older original events.

sharedRules.text: Use the actual class-access row, earned repertoire/preparation, casting ability, normal PB, current components, costs, strain and exact beginning/ending hooks. Woven Threads and Creation are rank5/base10RP; Haze is rank6/base13RP. All are Action, V/S/F and Instantaneous, with no ongoing concentration. Ordinary casting commits its Action, actual payment, components, prospective concentration consequence where relevant, first-family history and Refrain before the real counter window. Countering, invalidation after legal commitment or hidden failure refunds nothing. A known illegal declaration commits nothing. No generic upcast, additional save, actor, material, repertoire, feature or free Action is supplied. A Wizard's automatic school bonuses and first prepared-family exemption retain actual scopes; first-family exemption does not erase explicit extra strain or Refrain. Actual all-source recovery/absorption protections retain their exact scopes; no resource-generating permission follows from a memory or material receipt.

sharedRules.classification: KEEP ordinary Ready; NEW Woven temporal-selector detail only
sharedRules.text: Ordinary Ready pays one actual casting transaction at preparation, including its one Counterspell window, and requires its real concentration slot through resolution. It expires at the next regular own START; a response at that deadline is too late. A perceived trigger completes first, then a legal release spends the real Reaction and selects actual targets/area under its fixed spell/mode and preparation choices. No second RP/component/history/counter transaction occurs. Woven fixes Erase/Replace, its complete <=60-word narrative or event-description, and FIXED or RELATIVE temporal selection at preparation; its actual creature is selected at release. FIXED timestamps remain fixed. RELATIVE offsets become fixed at legal release before hidden results. Haze's intrinsic window is always resolution-relative. Creation fixes composition, mass, reference value, intended shape/profile and studied credentials at preparation; supported placement is selected at release. Release cannot edit the recorded payload in response to a save, hidden ineligibility or a missed memory window. Losing the hold before resolution prevents the payload. These nonconcentration effects release their hold after instantaneous resolution. No copied-feat allowance, new interrupt or extra Reaction is imported. COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 remains separately unchanged.

sharedRules.classification: NEW two-spell episodic-history completion; inherits accepted Disrupt Memory distinctions
sharedRules.text: All memory intervals use exact elapsed timestamps and half-open [start,end) boundaries. Prior experiences at the lower bound qualify; experiences at resolution time itself do not. Concurrent source applications retain actual authoritative sequence ordering without changing older event timestamps. Eligibility concerns personally experienced episodic event/facet IDs, not the date asserted by a story. No experience is manufactured during unconsciousness or an interval actually unobserved. A currently inaccessible real episode can receive another otherwise eligible edit; a present thought about yesterday is a new thought event, not authority to edit yesterday. Store true original experienced content privately and separately from accessible overlays, actual world events, external records, independent learned facts and gameplay resource/history ledgers. Successful later Haze/Woven edits dominate accessible family content only on their actual intersections; preserve earlier unrecovered layers and original DCs beneath them. Death/revival, loading, initiative transitions and ordinary rest do not wipe this provenance. Instantaneous completion leaves a lasting recollection change, not a live spell to dispel/suppress later. Actual antimagic can prevent its local manifestation at resolution. This grants no Charmed, hard-denial admission, compelled decision, automatic concentration ending, training deletion, formula grant, retroactive consent, resource refund or action reversal. A password learned solely in an edited event may be inaccessible, while older independently held knowledge survives. Creature type alone is not a mental immunity. Actual memory/mind defenses apply only within their own text. No private event IDs, unseen roster, DC, source identity or eligibility reason are exposed to a caster by success/failure.

sharedRules.classification: NEW Woven/Haze-only evidence recovery, explicitly selected; not a global memory rule
sharedRules.text:
After acquiring specific credible independent evidence, the recipient may undertake ten uninterrupted minutes (600 actual seconds) of active examination. It is not a free Action, short rest, ritual cast, new recovery pool or time-discounted research project. Select one continuous real interval <=60 seconds and a fixed method/evidence set before the attempt. Each evidence record carries immutable/versioned ID, independent provenance, actual lawful recipient access/comprehension, concrete corroborated/contradicted original event IDs and exact covered subinterval/facets. Coverage must be affirmatively authored from that evidence, not inferred from a contradiction elsewhere. The attempt's eligible portion is the union of covered personally experienced facets inside the selected interval. Gaps and unsupported events remain unaffected. A witness can supply credible independent evidence of a shared event; parroting the altered recipient, an unsupported assertion, a forged/ineligible record or repetition of the same item is not authenticated coverage. A mere named event, true private server log or casting suspicion is not player-accessible evidence. The private validator must not turn refusal, dice visibility or completion into a hidden-truth oracle; public presentation is limited to the recipient's genuine recovered own recollection and their ordinary evidence, with no source/DC/roster disclosure.
At completion revalidate actual reviewed evidence and qualifying portion; use the highest original application DC among all still-unrecovered Haze/Woven edits intersecting that portion, including layers masked by later edits. A weaker recast cannot lower an existing higher DC. Roll the recipient's actual WIS(Insight) task once, with real applicable proficiency and Core natural shifts. Success/Critical Success removes only the selected covered intersections from every relevant Haze/Woven restriction and reveals the true original wherever no independent source still blocks it. Neither degree grants bonus facts, older episodes, caster identity or compelled belief/truth. Failure/Critical Failure changes no memory and supplies no false certainty or extra injury. The same failed evidence/method/portion cannot be rerolled without materially new independently recorded evidence or a genuinely distinct usable method; mere relabelling/reordering is not novelty. An interrupted attempt gets no roll or recovery and must perform a fresh full600 seconds; no partial-time bank. Retain attempt start/end, interruption/failure fingerprint, roll, DC, covered event IDs, prior/edit intersections and idempotent settlement ID. A duplicate completion cannot roll or restore again.
No last-minute limit applies to recovery itself: the original edits were constrained at application, not erased from history by age. This rule removes only this named family. In particular, accepted Disrupt Memory's independent firsthand loss remains; evidence may teach new facts about it without restoring its erased firsthand experience. Another genuinely authorized memory-restoration effect uses its own complete source. In simultaneous/concurrent cases, no retry or restoration silently modifies a different source or post-start unexamined evidence. The selected interval/evidence cannot be enlarged after the result. An actually live separately authored Erase from Reality identity mask still controls access to the memory it masks after this family's restrictions are removed. This recovery does not end that mask, its untargetability or its own typed deadline. The accepted source's actual ending may later expose the surviving original; no new interaction permission is inferred from a similar name. Ordinary examination of an unhelpful record remains possible at its real time/opportunity cost. The absence of a private recovery DC is never a free player-facing authenticity or hidden-edit test, a refunded work order, or permission to disclose whether a particular event was truly changed.

sharedRules.classification: NEW Creation-only physical-lot and exact local partition completion
sharedRules.text:
Each successful Creation has one immutable root production ID and exact positive total mass, composition, creation timestamp, ordinary undamaged reference value and current/max structural state. Physical slices carry exact rational shares, source/sample/profile identity, previous custody, consumed/waste status and structural history. No silent second original lot, invented donor, soul identity, duplicated ingredient, cash or harvest stock is created. Before an actually lawful physical cut resolves, fix its parent leaf, geometrical cut plan, exact positive child/residue masses and unique immutable ordinal child IDs in neutral plan order. Their mass sum must equal that parent's actual available mass; record separately any source-authorized removed/consumed waste. Deal actual cutting damage at its actual source's stated order; a split itself grants no free cutting method, time, tool, proficiency or damage exemption.
For parent integer M>=C>=0 and exact positive weights w_i=m_i/sum(m), compute max floors floor(M*w_i); distribute remaining max points to descending fractional max remainder, ties by the predeclared child ID. Compute current floors floor(C*w_i); distribute remaining current points by descending current fractional remainder and the same tie rule, skipping children already at assigned maximum. Repeat the stable scan only while units remain; finite total capacity guarantees termination. Preserve exact total mass, reference value fractions, sum maximum M and sum current C. Current<=maximum for every leaf, including zero/zero. Rounding is spell-local structural accounting, not global currency or damage rounding.
Actual irreversible cut history controls. A later cut subdivides only its actual current parent leaf with that leaf's HP and lineage; it never rebalances detached siblings from root totals. The direct-three-way and staged-two-way allocations may differ and are both legitimate recorded histories. Renaming/reordering leaves after learning rounding results is not a new lawful partition. Combining, bundling, rejoining or Mending does not coalesce the leaves into a fresh apportionment parent or move structural points/damage between them. A cut of such an assembly acts on each participating original leaf separately and retains its share IDs. A later genuinely authorized full manufacturing/repair operation can have its own actual output/repair state, but must consume/account for the real inputs and costs; it is not a free merge/re-cut repair or duplicated value. At current0 retain real mass and fragments and no usable item benefits; zero-maximum fragments remain raw matter, not independently functioning equipment. Actual composition/shape and recipe eligibility decide whether that matter is usable, recoverable or waste. Consumed/burnt/missing mass cannot be restored by reclassification. No absorption, duplicate callback, transfer, ordinary rest or history reload regenerates material. Structural zero alone does not classify chemical composition, contamination, food safety or ingredient identity. Raw zero-maximum or Broken matter may still be genuine recipe stock or edible matter only where its actual physical condition and source-qualified process permit; it gains no functioning weapon/tool/armor durability merely by bundling.
